scenes.title: A clear altitude instruction
scenes.blurb: Every word is heard. The model commits to one interpretation, and the predicted trajectories descend toward 8,000 ft while history alone extrapolates level flight.
scenes.said: united two four seven eight descend and maintain eight thousand, maintain present heading
scenes.heard: united two four seven eight descend and maintain eight thousand, maintain present heading

scenes.title: A misheard instruction
scenes.blurb: The controller asked to maintain 4,000 ft and increase speed. The recognizer heard only “climb five”. The belief spreads over a few interpretations near the climb the aircraft is already flying.
scenes.said: delta six eight zero heavy maintain four thousand, increase speed to two six zero knots
scenes.heard: delta six eight zero heavy climb five

scenes.title: Callsign and turn direction lost
scenes.blurb: Only “fly heading three three five” was heard. The model still assigns the transmission to this aircraft and infers a left turn, the shorter way from a track of 023° to 335°.
scenes.said: echo juliett alpha eight zero zero turn left heading three three five

scenes.title: Callsign misheard, turn direction lost
scenes.blurb: “Alaska” was heard as “air transport” and “turn right” was dropped. The model infers a right turn, the shorter way from a track of 297° to 335°.
scenes.said: alaska one one five turn right heading three three five cleared to land runway three zero
scenes.heard: air transport one one five heading three three five cleared to land runway three zero

scenes.title: Callsign not heard
scenes.blurb: Only the instruction was heard. The climb is consistent with this aircraft's state, so the model assigns the transmission to it.
scenes.said: delta seven four three climb and maintain one six thousand
scenes.heard: climb and maintain one six thousand

scenes.title: A transmission for another aircraft
scenes.blurb: The transmission is for Swift 570, not this aircraft (Alaska 570). The model reads it as addressed elsewhere and keeps the prediction close to history alone.
scenes.said: swift five seven zero descend and maintain one thousand good afternoon
scenes.heard: swift five seven zero descend and maintain one thousand good afternoon

scenes.title: A frequency change
scenes.blurb: The transmission addresses this aircraft but instructs no maneuver. The model reads it as such and does not invent one.
scenes.said: echo juliett alpha eight three four contact oakland tower one one eight point one good day
scenes.heard: echo juliett alpha eight three four contact oakland tower one one eight point one good day

scenes.title: A case where composition does worse
scenes.blurb: The model reads “climb and maintain three thousand” confidently, but the aircraft climbs through 3,000 ft within the next 60 s, for example under a later clearance. The prediction levels off too early and is worse than history alone.
scenes.said: foxtrot bravo uniform eight five climb and maintain three thousand
scenes.heard: foxtrot bravo uniform eight five climb and maintain three thousand

note: Synthetic test transmissions (simulated speech recognizer) on real ADS-B tracks. Final model, first training run, K = 12 interpretations x S = 6 trajectories.
